title: Robot Emotion Display Control Panel
description: One distance reading driving a face and a buzzer at the same time -- plus the hysteresis band that stops both flickering.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Sensor, Sound, and IoT Project Kits

educational.audience: Students combining a display kit and a sound kit

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a simulated distance reading, the learner demonstrates how a single sensor value can drive both a robot display kit's expression and a robot sounds kit's audio cue simultaneously.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Drag the distance slider past the trigger and watch both outputs react; mute one and see the other unaffected
pedagogical.assessment: Ask why muting the speaker does not change the face.
